description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses from MTD partitions specific to the Phicomm K2T device. It loads configuration data in JSON format and provides a function to retrieve MAC addresses based on key input.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads the configuration JSON data from the MTD partition named 'config'.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves a MAC address value from the configuration JSON, given a specific key.
